name: Figma AI
freeTierNote: Starter $0 plan includes 150 AI credits/day (up to 500/mo).

pricingTiers.name: Professional (Full seat)
pricingTiers.note: $20/mo monthly, or $16/mo billed annually (3,000 AI credits/mo inside Figma seats)

priceBand: Starter $0 (500 AI credits/mo); Professional Full seat $20/mo ($16/mo annual) (Nov 2026)
bestFor: Designers already in Figma who want first-pass layers, not a new tool
skipIf: You do not have a Figma seat
keyFeatures: Generates editable Figma layers, not flat PNGs
First-party integration inside existing design files
Speeds up placeholder copy and layout variations
limitations: Requires an existing paid Figma seat for full access
Generated screens still need contrast and design-system review
summary: AI that emits Figma objects. That single fact beats a hundred screenshot generators.
body: If the file has to be a Figma file, generate in Figma. Everything else is a picture of a UI. AI is a credit allowance inside Figma seats rather than a separate product—Starter includes limited daily/monthly AI credits, while Professional Full seats include a larger monthly pool. v0 is the engineer-facing cousin.
notes: Do not paste generated screens into production without contrast checks
Adobe is the other design-suite gravity well
